events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 1–0 at 아스널 with an early goal from Dennis Bergkamp , their first Premier League defeat since the opening day of the season, and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 extend their lead to five points with a 2–1 home win over 리버풀, with Steve Howey scoring a late winner. 맨체스터 시티 finally win a Premier League at the 12th attempt, being fellow strugglers Bolton 1–0 at Maine Road . In Division One, 셰필드 유나이티드 climb off the bottom of the table and out of the bottom three with a 4–1 home win over 포츠머스. Tranmere beat 더비 카운티 5-1 and Stoke beat Luton 5–0.
노팅엄 포리스트 go third in the Premier League with a 4–1 win over 윔블던, who remain fourth from bottom.
첼시 sign Romanian defender Dan Petrescu from 셰필드 웬즈데이 for a club record fee of £2.3million.
The FA withdraws its £118.5-million television deal with Football League clubs after they failed to meet a deadline.

In the FA Cup 's first round, 슈루즈버리 타운 defeat Northern Premier League side Marine by a club-record 11-2 and Division Two crisis club 스완지 시티 lose 7–0 to Division Three side 풀럼 . Division Two's 브래드퍼드 시티 are made to work hard for a 4–3 win over non-league 버턴 앨비언 . Hitchin Town , another non-league side, eliminate 브리스틀 로버스 with a 2–1 win. Dorchester Town lose 9–1 to 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 .

Former England manager Graham Taylor resigns after 20 months managing 울버햄프턴 원더러스 , who began the season as Division One promotion favourites but have fallen to 17th. His final game in charge, a televised home match against 10-man 찰턴 애슬레틱 in the league, ended in a goalless draw.
케니 달글리시 , director of football at 블랙번 로버스 since June after guiding them to the Premier League title, is reported to be in the running to be the new 울버햄프턴 원더러스 manager.

Alan Shearer scores a hat-trick for 블랙번 로버스 in their 7–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트, while leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 draw at 애스턴 빌라, enabling 맨체스터 유나이티드 to cut the gap at the top to six points (and having the advantage of a game in hand) with their 4–1 home win over 사우샘프턴.
Manager Ronald Spelbos is fired by Dutch club 피테서 and replaced by Frans Thijssen .

맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 코번트리 시티 4–0 at Highfield Road to cut the gap at the top to three points and sent their opponents to the bottom of the Premier League table. Bolton miss the chance to climb out of the bottom three as they lose 3–2 at 첼시. 맨체스터 시티's slow improvement continues with a 1–0 win over 윔블던 at Maine Road.
리즈 유나이티드 pay a club record £4.5million for 파르마 's Swedish striker Tomas Brolin . 에버턴 striker Duncan Ferguson is released from prison after serving 44 days of his three-month sentence for assault.

34-year-old defender Steve Nicol returns to the Premier League less than a year after leaving 리버풀 for a 노츠 카운티 side now in Division Two, signing for 셰필드 웬즈데이. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 remain in the driving seat at the top of the Premier League with a 2–1 home win over Leeds. Coventry and 윔블던 both grind out a point in the battle for Premier League survival with a thrilling 3–3 draw at Highfield Road.

The Football League signs a five-year television-coverage deal worth £125 million with BSkyB . 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 draw with 노팅엄 포리스트 at the City Ground , with Eric Cantona converting a penalty to equalise in the second half after the home side took the lead. They have now played as many games as leaders 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 but are still five points behind.
아약스 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating Brazil's Grêmio after penalties: 4–3. The decisive penalty is scored by skipper Danny Blind .
